title: Baseten and Goodfire AI Launch First Integrated Open Model Safety Stack
summary:
Corporate clients can now monitor AI runtime to identify risks in third party intelligence via a new collaborative toolset. Baseten and Goodfire AI launched Project Beacon on Oct. 9 to integrate real-time inference and in-line monitoring for the first time, allowing operators to catch safety signals proactively during the execution of open weights models.

The partnership aims to provide a frontier alignment stack to ensure consistent safety infrastructure regardless of where a model is sourced. The firms are already offering the system to enterprise customers and state that such tools will become critical as open intelligence models increase in capability.
